annotations.title: Email check: syntax, MX, SPF/DMARC, disposable and role address, deliverability verdict

description: Use when an agent is about to email or sign up a contact. Input: email. Output: JSON verdict (deliverable, risky, undeliverable) with reasons, MX hosts, null MX, SPF and DMARC policy, disposable domain, role account, free provider. No SMTP probe, so the mailbox itself is not verified. Malformed address refused before payment. Use instead: domain_lookup for the whole domain. Example: ?email=info@example.com Price: $0.002 per call, paid in USDC (Base, Monad, Polygon, Arbitrum or Solana) via x402.
